releases.displayName: The Steering Wheel Update is now live!

items.text: Hello Fellow Rally Racers!
As promised, we are excited to announce that the new update featuring improved steering wheel support is now available for everyone.
A huge thank you to everyone who participated in the closed testing phase. Your feedback, time, and support have been invaluable in helping us shape this feature.
Improved Wheel Support
Now most of the wheels from major brands should be properly supported.
New Feature: Wheel Rebinding

We’ve also added a dedicated wheel rebinding system, allowing you to customize your setup more easily. If your steering wheel isn’t officially supported, this new feature may help you get up and running.
As always, we’d love to hear your feedback, see you on the stages!
Frozen Lake Games & Astrolabe Games
Hey Racers!
A new patch is live, bringing several important fixes thanks to your valuable feedback.
Rally Selection Menu: Resolved an issue where the Super Cars and Rally S Cup events displayed incorrect cars and stages and fixed menu accessibility
Settings: Fixed the screen resolution drop-down list scrolling behavior
Updated Chinese and Japanese translations for the latest achievements
Addressed various minor bugs and overall stability improvements
*UPDATE v1.0.989b
Super Cars and Rally S Cup events are now working properly and reward car can be unlocked as expected
Console version patches will follow shortly, as additional time is required for certification and deployment.
As always, thank you for your continued patience, passion, and support. See you on the track!
Cheers,
Frozen Lake Games & Astrolabe Games
Hello Fellow Rally Racers,
Today, we are happy to announce that all the planned model re-work is done!

notes.title: The final two missing cars are back in the game

items.text: Avalanche A1
Libra Daria

With these additions, all 13 affected cars have now been restored with freshly built, original models.

As part of this update, later we’ll also be manually removing any incompatible car liveries that were made for the old models. We know many of these designs hold great memories — they’re some of our personal favorites too — so it’s unfortunate that we have to say goodbye. But we’re confident our creative community will come back strong with amazing new liveries for the updated models!
To celebrate, we’re kicking off the 2nd Community Livery Contest this Thursday, exclusively for the reworked cars. We can’t wait to see what you come up with!
If you’re new to Old School Rally’s Workshop feature, you can check out our quick-start guide here:
[dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3334278536"]
Of course, taking this opportunity, we've also made some bug fixes...
Disabled ghost car in Photo Mode
Fixed Gemini ZR headlights
Fixed Tiny S hood visuals
Fixed Zeta GRT visuals
We'll come back with the details for the Workshop Contest soon!
Cheers,
Frozen Lake Games & Astrolabe Games
Dear Rally Racers,
Thank you once again for your continued support and valuable feedback. Every improvement in Old School Rally has been closely shaped by your passionate suggestions and genuine critiques.

This patch primarily focuses on adjustments to the (Infamous) China SS1 and SS2. We believe this patch will help balance the difficulty of the China stage and create a smoother overall difficulty curve in Rally Mode.
We invite you to jump back onto the stages and events to experience the changes - and please let us know how you feel!
Rally Stages
Reduced difficulty by reducing track length and required times for China SS1/SS2
Fixed some walls and road collisions in China SS1/SS2
Fixed an invisible wall that resets the car when hit in Germany SS1
Reduced required time for Finland SS3
Rally Events
Reduced the number of appearances of China stages in early Rally events and replaced them with other stages
Reduced overall required times for World Tour events
Other Fixes
Reverted some menu fonts to the previous version for better readability
Daily Challenge: Fixed incorrect stages display of Germany
Frozen Lake Games & Astrolabe Games

releases.displayName: Split-Screen Mode, New Stages, New Cars, and More! - Fall 2024 Major Update

items.text: Hello, Racers!
The long-awaited Fall major update for Old School Rally is finally here! Here's a breakdown of the new features and content included in this update:
1. Split-Screen Mode

Split-screen mode has finally arrived! Access this feature via the “Arcade” option in the main menu. Challenge your buddies and enjoy some serious rallyracing or have fun bumping into each other - either way, it’ll be a different experience than playing solo.
Split-screen is available for local couch-op only, but thanks to Steam Remote Play players from afar can sit together virtually!
2. New Vehicle: Pada B82
Inspired by one of the best-selling cars in the history of automobile, by popular demand, the Pada B82 arrives in Old School Rally!
3. Four New Stages
Yes - we know what you folks wanted, and we have been working on new landscapes, new stage features, and finally would like to present you:
Arizona SS1;
United Kindom SS1;

And two new variants of fan-favorite tracks from Finland and Sweden.: 4. New S-Class Rally Events: With these new stages, we’ve also added two new S-Class rally events.: 5. New Weather Effect: Foggy Weather: Not only available in the Time Trial mode, it will also retroactively appear in some rally events now.: 6. Workshop Livery Contest "Best Original" Winner: Sushi Delivery Van: Introducing the winning design from the Workshop Livery contest, the Sushi RV by "bacon"! You can now easily switch between subscribed car skins without reopening the Workshop.: 7. New Soundtracks: We’ve added five new tracks, available during races and in the retro music player.: 8. Improved Steering Wheel Support: We’re continually working to improve the gameplay experience for steering wheel users. If you encounter any issues with steering wheel controls, please let us know.: 9. Weather Effects in Photo Mode and Replay Mode.: Weather effects are now visible in both photo mode and the replay system.: 10. Wipers in Cockpit View for Rainy Weather: The cockpit view now displays windshield wipers in motion on rainy days.: 11. New Collectibles to Unlock: 12. Additional Bug Fixes and Quality of Life Improvements: This is the second major update since the Early Access launch, and we hope that with split-screen mode, you’ll introduce Old School Rally to even more friends who enjoy racing games. We’re committed to listening to your feedback and bringing even more content to enhance your experience.: Thank you for your continued support; even more updates await you in the future!: Frozen Lake Games & Astrolabe Games

releases.displayName: A Sneak Peek at the Massive Fall Update

items.text: Hello, Racers!

It’s been a while since our last update for Old School Rally, but that’s because we’ve been working on a massive new update behind the scenes - It will be our biggest and most complex update yet, so we need a bit more time for preparation and testing.
Today, however, we’re excited to share a preview of what’s coming!
Expect a few new stages featuring some fresh (and more complex) terrains across different countries!
Got friends over? Try out split-screen play! Just remember: friendship first, competition second!

*Important - The local split-screen will suport Steam Remote Play Together (https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay#together) so we'll make sure that you can have a virtual couch with your friends as long as the Internet connection is available!
Of course we'll have new cars! Thanks to our passionate community, we know exactly what you want to see and we are working on those!
Expect some fresh tunes in this update!
More weather effects are on the way - you don't get to choose the weather on race day, but you can certainly do that in game!
We’re also implementing some additioinal tweaks and fixes to improve your gameplay experience.
This is a quick overview of what’s in the shop right now. We’ll be continuing our testing over the coming weeks to ensure the machine is in its top shape. Stay tuned!
Changelog v1.0.9
New Feature
Added "Apply" and "Default" buttons in the Workshop menu for applying downloaded liveries and restoring default liveries.
Custom livery feature now supports artwork on wheels.
Improvements
Vehicle livery files will automatically adjust their size to avoid excessive memory usage.
Increased the maximum adjustable field of view in photo mode.
Fixed some texture issues with the vehicle Jupiter Ram.
Fixed an issue that could occur when selecting menu options in the main menu.
Known Issue
We have identified that the spinning menu bug is caused by the connection of unsupported wheel devices. We will continue to investigate this issue for a prompt resolution.
That's it for this time! Next patch will also be as exciting so stay tuned!

releases.displayName: The 1st Major Update Goes Live & Guide

items.text: The Wait is Over! The First Major Update for Old School Rally is Now Live!
We’re excited to share a detailed overview of everything included in this major update:

New Major Feature Added - Steam Workshop: You can now create, share, or simply use vehicle liveries made by other players. This is just the beginning—we plan to expand the Workshop's features in future updates!
Note: The process can be a bit complex, so please check the Steam Guide section for detailed instructions: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3334278536
New Vehicle Added: A new car - Panter DR3 is now available.
New Feature Added: Retro Music Player
Enjoy a curated selection of tunes from our development team anytime outside of races with this retro-style music player!
We’ve added purchasable items for even more customization and decoration options for your collection shelf. More to come!
Complete the Moonlight and Classics events to unlock corresponding achievements.
We’ve addressed an issue where unsupported steering wheels caused menu rotation errors. This fix is still in testing, so we appreciate your feedback!

notes.title: Improved Dust Particle Effects for Replay

items.text: Dust and dirt effects are now clearer in the replay system.
Resolved an issue with the TRACTOR vehicle not displaying correctly in replays.
Fixed a wall-clipping bug in China SS1.
Fixed a collision node near checkpoint 3 in Finland SS2.
Improved localization in certain areas.
A number of other bug fixes and overall improvements.

This major update is packed with content, and the developers have poured immense effort into making it a reality. To celebrate, we’ve also launched a brand new community event with amazing prizes! We’d love for you to participate!

On top of that, we'd truly appreciate if you can do us favour by recommending Old School Rally to your friends who would enjoy that retro racing games the old way. Our dedication remains unwavering—to the past, present, and future—as we continue to bring you the best updates and improvements possible.
This is just the first major update, with plenty more to come. Thank you for your continued support!
Best regards,
Frozen Lake Games & Astrolabe Games

All Open Rally events progress can now be saved properly
Photo Mode: Car particles (dust, smoke, skid marks etc.) are now visible.
Visual improvements in some stages (Greece, Sweden, Australia)

releases.displayName: Old School Rally is now officially Steam Deck VERIFIED!

items.text: Hey Racers!
While a lot of you folks are already playing Old School Rally on Steam Deck flawlessly, we'd still like to announce that Old School Rally is now officially Steam Deck Verified!

That means Old School Rally gets the fancy green "Deck Verified" mark on its storepage, and of course, you will be able to discover Old School Rally under the "Great on Deck" category on your favourite portable gaming device!
Cheers!
The Dev & Publishing Team

items.text: Dear Players,
We are overwhelmed by the incredible feedback and support from the community following the release of 'Old School Rally''s demo on Steam Next Fest!
Rest assured that all your voices are heard, and we are dedicated to improving the game based on the community's valuable insights, starting with this demo update:
Fixed the downshifting gear control;
Temporarily disabled the controller vibration function that was causing frame drops for some users;
Improved braking;
Fixed intro videos for Steam Deck compatibility;
*We also noticed the current gear 5/6 "meta" in the time trial but decided not to fix it this time around in order to maintain the consistency of the time trial contest, so enjoy it while you can : )

In the meantime, we are working on further improvements on handling/physics and popular feature requests (such as Ghost, Day/Night cycle, etc.). We promise we'll work hard to answer your expectations for 'Old School Rally' so please stay tuned!
Until next time,
Dev & Publishing Team
